chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'gents 9ct yellow gold signet ring' and '9ct gold signet ring plain round' (filter Australia, sold, last 90 days, note grams and price). Also Noble Numismatics and Leski realised prices for '9ct signet ring', and The-Saleroom / Denhams / Gowans for weight-stated sales. Compare price per gram against current 9ct scrap.
viewing_check: Look under the shank or inside the band for a 9ct/375 stamp and hallmark (Birmingham/Chester assay marks, date letter, maker); weigh the ring and note the size. Without a stamp, ask for acid test. Check the shank is not split or thin.
rate_note: All figures taken as AUD as printed in the database; the UK Denhams records show only $ so currency should be confirmed.
